title: Design a requirements map, strategy view, and roadmap from BRIEF.md
summary: Write one design doc, docs/design/requirements-map.md. It maps each BRIEF.md requirement, addenda included, to a status, an owning design under docs/design/, and the jobs that serve it. It also specifies the living strategy view (A1) and a roadmap that sequences the queued work. No code changes.

defaults_applied.how: The doc is written for an outside reader, with terms defined.
Statuses cite BRIEF.md sections, CHANGELOG entries and design docs; estimates are labeled.
The design lists alternatives, e.g. generated versus hand-kept map.
One new doc and no code.
The repository was read to fill in the A1 and addenda structure.
The doc marks which update rules are prose-only, since no mechanism is built.

assumptions: 'Serving jobs' means the Athena jobs and landed commits that advanced a requirement; the doc cites them by the evidence available in the repository (CHANGELOG.md, docs/design/, docs/decisions.md), since records/ is absent.
'Queued work' is the set of BRIEF.md requirements with no landed design or implementation, plus any queue named in the BRIEF or docs.
The map is a hand-maintained Markdown document with a specified update rule. No generator or checker is built, because the request says design doc only.
The doc goes in docs/design/ in the style of existing designs.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/design/requirements-map.md exists and has a table with one row per BRIEF.md requirement, including each addendum and A1 through A13, with columns for status, owning design doc, and serving jobs.
Every owning design cited points to an existing file under docs/design/ or is explicitly marked 'none yet'. Every status value is defined in the doc.
A section specifies the living strategy view for A1: its source of truth, how it is updated, and how it is kept current instead of regenerated by hand.
A roadmap section orders the queued work with the reason for each dependency, and names what is not yet scheduled.
The doc lists alternatives considered, cites BRIEF.md sections as sources, and labels estimates. It contains no secrets or personal data.
Run `git status` and `git diff`: only Markdown files under docs/ (plus optional CHANGELOG.md) changed. No Rust, config, governance, or records/ files changed.

out_of_scope: Implementing a generator, checker, or any Rust code for the map.
Building the A1 strategy view itself.
departures: Slightly higher cost than the reference, because the producer must read all of BRIEF.md (about 440+ lines) and the existing designs to map them.
